en:
Nyeh...? You need to talk to me 
or something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?
Are you bored? You can come with me.

I'm tired... If I don't rest now, I won't 
make it to tonight...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time relaxing with Himiko,
who had tired herself out being positive.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
